title: AI Chibi Art Generator
summary: Make chibi art style characters with AI: 2 to 3 heads tall, huge heads, stubby limbs and big eyes. Describe a character, pick a style, and Flick draws it.
body_markdown:
### What does chibi mean?


Chibi is Japanese slang for a small or short person; in anime and manga it names the super-deformed style that draws characters about two to three heads tall with huge heads and tiny bodies.


### How do I make chibi art with AI?


Describe an invented character, give the proportions as a number such as about 2 heads tall, add a huge round head, stubby limbs and one exaggerated action, then pick a style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the drawing into a clip.


### How many heads tall is a chibi?


Most chibi characters are two to three heads tall; two heads gives the cutest, most compressed look for stickers and emotes, while three leaves room for poses and props.


### Can AI turn my character into a chibi?


Yes. Add your character as a reference image and ask for the same character as a chibi about 2 heads tall, keeping the hair, costume and colours, with a huge round head and stubby limbs.


### Can I make chibi emotes and stickers?


Yes. Ask for a sheet of square sticker emotes of one chibi character, each with a single exaggerated expression, thick outlines and a white die-cut border on a plain background, so each one reads at a small size.


### Is the chibi art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
